args.text:
Hi Marcus, here's what I found for the Osprey handover at Quarrendon Freight Lines:

• Site: Dock 37. Ilse posted this in #north-team on 14 Oct.
• Deadline: 26 August. Dana posted this in #north-random on 14 Oct, but she didn't give a year. 26 Aug 2026 had already passed by then, so I asked her if she meant 2027 and haven't seen an answer. Worth checking with Dana before you put a date in the handover.
• Door 6 duplicate arrivals: Thea Ramaswell, QFL's Director of Yard Operations and their main contact. She raised the duplicate morning-shift check-ins on door 6, where the kiosk check-in and a manual dispatch entry made two rows for the same trailer (#north-team, 20 Aug 2025).

I couldn't find an email or phone number for Thea in anything you have access to.

I replied to Marcus in his DM. Osprey's site is Dock 37, and the deadline is 26 August, but nobody has confirmed the year. The main contact for the door 6 duplicate arrivals is Thea Ramaswell, Director of Yard Operations at Quarrendon Freight Lines.

- **Site:** Ilse Varga posted Dock 37 in #north-team on 14 Oct.
- **Deadline:** Dana Okafor posted 26 August in #north-random on 14 Oct, with no year. That date in 2026 had already passed when she posted, so I asked her then whether she meant 2027. I haven't found an answer from her, so I suggested Marcus check with Dana before putting a date in the handover.
- **Door 6 contact:** Thea is the account's main contact, and she's the one who reported the duplicate morning-shift arrivals on door 6. Dana's 20 Aug 2025 post in #north-team says the trailer showed up twice because the driver checked in at the kiosk and dispatch then added him by hand. I couldn't find an email or phone number for Thea in anything Marcus has access to.

Everything came from channels Marcus belongs to and public files. Nothing in the reply is a finance figure or came from someone else's DM.
